scope: Independent re-score of the two real specialist renders for 79 requests. The 63 distinct physical-location labels were fixed before viewing requested roles or either model output. These are original-pixel AI visual assessments. Each of the 16 source signatures, every complete original JPEG hash, every input row hash and all 158 source-view hashes were authenticated or recomputed locally. Wide and close are separate views evaluated by the same model. No model or runtime code was changed by this evaluation.
complete_controls_policy: On each original, require all three source controls to avoid simultaneous OPEN in both views. Only candidate points also called OPEN in both views survive. The global policy then requires at least one independently verified offer and zero independently wrong offers.

findings: Five of ten independently eligible directional points obtained two OPEN readings. Among the fifteen candidate points classified OPEN in both views, eight were independently unsuitable and two were visually uncertain. An open-looking patch can sit behind an adjacent parked car, in front of its bonnet or several stalls away from the requested vehicle.

A two-view rule alone also accepted seven of sixteen occupied controls, four of sixteen nominal road controls and six of sixteen reversed-side requests. Three reversed controls were genuinely eligible on the opposite side in the independent read. These source challenges are distinct from the 31 actual candidate decisions.

Rejecting every source with a two-view OPEN control removed eleven whole photographs, including the five genuine dual-view positive points. The two surviving candidates on the other five photographs were physically incorrect. The signed lateral bank consequently produces no qualified global release.
